name: gizza-ai/find-duplicate-lines
summary: List lines that appear more than once, with counts

tool.description: List the lines that appear more than once in the text, with how many times each occurs (most frequent first). Set ignore_case=true to compare case-insensitively and trim=true to ignore surrounding whitespace. Returns total/unique line counts and the list of duplicates with their counts. Runs locally.

text.description: The text whose lines should be checked for duplicates.

trim.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace from each line before comparing.
